title: 自助预览与通读

dependencies.change: Coordinator-authorized narrow fix to confirm: duplicate matching excludes revoked rows, so a full_read retried after revocation creates one new live row while a live duplicate stays idempotent. V6-05 remains 26/26.

interface.confirmationModel: V6-05 confirm over an actor-scoped append-only ledger. A successful first full_read atomically writes the ledger, confirmation.created activity event, and matter version update through LocalRepository's StorageBackend transaction. A live repeat returns the existing row without another event or version increment; a repeat after revocation creates a new live row, while the preview only reports a confirmation present in currentConfirmations.
interface.projectionBehavior: PreviewDTO is schema-validated and contains claims, sanitized technicalField/background, locked section kinds, sanitized RiskDTOs and inputStale. inputStale compares sourceVersion, targetConfigVersion and figureRevisionId with the current DraftInputRef. FullDraftDTO is present only for full or local_unmetered access. Locked section paragraph bodies and paragraph sourceRefs are excluded from preview DTO/UI.

acceptance.observed: A current local_unmetered revision produced a schema-valid full_read with identity=local_self_reported. The test verified a matching confirmation.created event and matter version increment.

Preview-only access returned no FullDraftDTO and no locked paragraph body or locked SourceRef quote in PreviewDTO/UI; partial locked excerpts in both risk title and explanation were replaced while an unlocked risk kept its text. V6-05 refused full_read with ACTION_FORBIDDEN. Changes to sourceVersion, targetConfigVersion or figureRevisionId each set inputStale; a changed source version additionally refused confirmation with STALE_BINDING and wrote no ledger row.

Reload returned only a live confirmation. Retrying a live full_read returned created=false with no duplicate event/version; after revocation, retry created a new id that was the sole current confirmation, and the preview hid the revoked row.

specAcceptance.reason: S05-A01 is the R2 cloud content-usage gate across preview, revisions, diff, job result and search. V6-20 is an R1 local preview component and adds no cloud endpoint, revision/diff/job/search projection, or entitlement check. The local PreviewDTO projection does satisfy the preview-only shape for claims/technical-field/background, locked section IDs and no locked body/sourceRefs; that local projection is exercised here, but it is not evidence for the R2 GWT.

A locked embodiments risk keeps its category, rule, section locator and useful generic explanation. Meaningful excerpts from locked paragraph text are replaced field-by-field with section-level copy; tests cover partial title/explanation quotes, a locked paragraph SourceRef quote, and unchanged unlocked risk text. Browser evidence locates and highlights the locked section.
AI paragraph confirmation reset after professional editing is an editor/save-revision behavior. This module is read-only; V6-18 covers that behavior.
Competing revision save and merge behavior belongs to the V6-18 editor revision seam, not this read-only preview.
Restore, restoredFrom, figureStrategy and confirmation non-inheritance require the restore command, outside the V6-20 write set.
This ticket displays source-version staleness and invokes the regenerate/adopt callbacks; it does not implement adopted_inputs creation or its confirmation dialog.
Risk acknowledgement and expert-service routing are separate risk_ack/service flows. V6-20 displays risks and does not create acknowledgements or service orders.
Invalid AST validation occurs on professional save. The preview is read-only and cannot save AST changes; V6-18 covers the claim dependency validation.
local_unmetered renders all six sections, the required local no-fee label, a full-read confirmation control, and no pay/unlock controls. Covered by scenario assertions and browser screenshots.

limitations: Node 22 was unavailable. Tests, typecheck, Vite build and browser harness ran on Node 25.8.1 / npm 11.11.0.
The full project package build script's post-build copy steps were not run. The production Vite build was executed in memory to keep generated artifacts out of the strict write set.

Preview is exported but not registered in V6App/navigation because those shared route files are outside this ticket's write set. The browser harness mounted the component directly; the full application route flow remains unverified.
access=preview was exercised through the contract projection and synthetic local fixture. No R2 server endpoints for revisions, diffs, job results, or search were changed or verified.
The risk list is supplied through the Preview interface; V6-20 does not implement a check-run/risk producer.

Repository and V6-05 confirmation behavior was exercised with the real LocalRepository over its StorageBackend contract and an in-memory test backend. Browser evidence also used a synthetic in-memory backend; native browser IndexedDB persistence was not separately exercised.
No real provider, customer material, external network request, payment, or deployment was used.

decisions.decision: Keep PreviewDTO as a strict redacted projection; deliver complete content in a separately validated FullDraftDTO only when access is full or local_unmetered.
Apply V6-05 confirm to the persisted actor-scoped ledger and atomically append confirmation.created plus matter version through the LocalRepository backend transaction.
Export Preview and generate S03/same-target draft links using v6Path. Shared app route registration remains orchestrator-owned.
